narrative:
Washington County has 41,074 registered voters, with 18.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 31.4% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 44.1%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 12.6 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.6% of registrants.
